fidelity_notes: These immutable snapshots define the reproduction cohort now; the original experiment did not release content-pinned benchmark snapshots, so identity with its private files is not established.

MATH-500 uses the same HuggingFaceH4 repository as upstream. GSM8K uses the official OpenAI JSONL and upstream final-answer normalization. All 1319 ordered question/answer records were independently confirmed equal to openai/gsm8k main/test at Hugging Face revision 740312add88f781978c0658806c59bc2815b9866 (parquet SHA-256 ee7b8da9e381df27b9e3f7758a159ab2bdaa4dbaa910546cbbc47e0cb44e4f59).
IFEval uses the official Google input_data.jsonl. Its source keys define stable IDs; the original unreleased weightenv preparation may have used different row IDs.
Canonical cohort digests include ordered raw prompts and gold answers/instructions. Inference requests project only IDs and prompts; gold answers remain in the trusted evaluator.

Pinned test cohorts are for frozen replay only. Practice/discovery cohort snapshots and normalized/13-word overlap audits remain unresolved; exact or normalized overlap checks alone do not establish freedom from contamination.
